_comment: The declared field for each Melbourne Cup, and the only place it is written.
gen-cup-field.mjs — never edit the field markup in the page by hand.
ON THE MORNING THE FIELD IS DECLARED (the Saturday before the race), the
whole job is: paste the 24 runners below, npm run build, deploy. That is the
point of this file — the alternative was hand-editing a table in HTML under
time pressure on a Saturday, which is how a wrong barrier number ships.
BEFORE declaredOn, runners here FAIL THE BUILD. A field that does not exist
yet must never reach the page, and this is written from experience: a set of
past runners with invented barriers was pasted in during development and the
only thing that stopped it shipping was remembering to undo it. Use
to render them locally for a look; the next ordinary build fails until this
Leave runners empty until the field is official. The page renders the
twenty-four saddlecloth numbers while it is empty — which is exactly what a
sweep drawn early draws from — and the same cells gain names once it is
filled. It is useful either way and never claims a field it lacks.
runners: { no, horse, barrier }. no is the saddlecloth number 1-24.
